Place Galio Q Winds of War where Zed will be pushed in, then use Galio E Justice Punch to push him into it. When Zed's combo comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with its taunt.
Zed.laning: Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand's shield is up. When it breaks, back off and wait for it to recharge. Hit both the wave and Zed with Galio Q Winds of War, then after pushing the lane, look for an angle to affect another lane with Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Zed.combo: When Zed's mobility is down, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the airborne duration ends, start charging Galio W Shield of Durand, then release it after a brief charge to follow up with a taunt. Overlap the vortex from Galio Q Winds of War at that spot. After landing your abilities, also use the empowered basic attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Zed.escape: If only Zed W Living Shadow is down, he can escape with Zed R Death Mark, so track the status of both mobility abilities. In particular, before Zed R Death Mark becomes available again, use the opening when the shadow disappears or Zed has already swapped positions to engage with Galio E Justice Punch and taunt with Galio W Shield of Durand.
Zed.phase: Zed becomes weaker in the late game, so Galio helps his allies with engages and crowd control.
Zed.teamfight: When an ally is engaged on, start casting Galio R Hero's Entrance to shield them before you arrive, then land where crowd control from your ally is holding the enemy and knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt Zed if he is positioned to attack your ally, preventing him from stacking damage. Place Galio Q Winds of War in a narrow entrance, and use Galio E Justice Punch to block Zed's escape route.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, it triggers sleep after a short delay. Move behind a wall or an ally during that time to get out of Zoe Q Paddle Star!'s angle and range. Even a bubble that misses remains as a trap, so watch narrow paths without vision and brush entrances. When Zoe throws Zoe Q Paddle Star! to line up an angle, interrupt her aim with Galio W Shield of Durand or Galio E Justice Punch.
Zoe.build: Build Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early to match Zoe's main damage and increase your magic resistance. Magic resistance helps Galio's defense and damage. However, resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so dodging the bubble comes first.
Zoe.fight: Close the distance and fight right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is used. When Zoe throws Zoe Q Paddle Star!, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch or taunt her with Galio W Shield of Durand to stop her from redirecting it. Galio's magic damage hits Zoe hard because she has low magic resistance, so after landing your abilities, follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash's empowered attack.
Zoe.combo: Once Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is used, knock Zoe up with Galio E Justice Punch, then before the knock-up ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand briefly and release it to follow up with a taunt. Place Galio Q Winds of War so its two gusts overlap at the spot Zoe will move into. Finish with Galio P Colossal Smash's empowered attack.
Zoe.escape: The moment after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is used is your chance to engage with Galio E Justice Punch. If Zoe used Zoe R Portal Jump, she must return to her starting point, so target that spot.
Zoe.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
Zoe.teamfight: After Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is used, look for an angle to get onto Zoe. If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero's Entrance early to shield them, then taunt the enemy threatening your ally with Galio W Shield of Durand after landing. Use Galio Q Winds of War to block a narrow approach and Galio E Justice Punch to block the enemy's escape route.
Zoe.laning: Use Galio Q Winds of War to hit both Zoe and the minions. If Galio W Shield of Durand's shield is broken, back off until it recharges. Engage right after Zoe uses a key ability on the minions, and usually save Galio E Justice Punch for disengaging.

Yasuo.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath deal most of their damage as physical damage, so build armor first. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: First use light poke to remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield, then commit to a trade. Right after Yasuo throws the Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado, he has no way to knock you up for a while, so look for a chance to catch him with Galio E Justice Punch and Galio W Shield of Durand. If Yasuo starts his combo first, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage and answer with a taunt.
Yasuo.laning: Use Galio Q Winds of War to hit both the wave and Yasuo, but manage your mana. Keep a thin wave pushed toward your side to reduce the minions Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Use Galio Q Winds of War to remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield first. Then knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch, and before the knock-up ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand briefly and release it to follow up with a taunt. Use Galio Q Winds of War so its two gusts overlap at that spot, then follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash's empowered attack.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws the Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado is your chance to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so don't go in just because he used it once; look for an opportunity with crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again. Use Galio E Justice Punch to close the distance, then Galio W Shield of Durand to keep him from escaping.
Yasuo.phase: In the late game, help your allies with engages and crowd control, and hold space at the front instead of focusing on damage.
Yasuo.teamfight: If you cast Galio R Hero's Entrance the moment an ally is caught, you can shield them before you arrive. Land where your ally's crowd control has caught the enemy to knock them up, then use Galio W Shield of Durand to peel enemies who are in position to catch your ally.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice in a row, his next Q becomes a tornado that knocks you up. Watch for the sound and visual effect when the stacks are full. When Yasuo approaches, move sideways instead of only backing away to dodge the narrow Q hitbox. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him approach by dashing through minions, so be careful not to give him minions to use as stepping stones.
